title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 22
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 22: the word at the king's house, the woe on unjust building, and what is said of Shallum, Jehoiakim and Coniah.

questions.text: Where was Jeremiah told to go down and speak this word?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak this word, there."

answers.text: To the valley of the dead bodies
To the court of the temple
To the house of the king of Judah
To the cities of Lebanon

questions.text: To which three people was the king told to do no violence?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said to do no violence to the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow, and not to shed innocent blood in this place.

answers.text: The foreigner, the fatherless and the widow
The priest, the prophet and the elder
The farmer, the shepherd and the craftsman
The servant, the captive and the stranger's son

questions.text: What did Yahweh swear by Himself would happen if they would not hear these words?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "But if you will not hear these words, I swear by myself, that this house will become a desolation."

answers.text: That no rain would fall on the land
That the throne would pass to a foreigner
That the people would be scattered among the islands
That this house would become a desolation

questions.text: What did Yahweh say the destroyers would cut down and cast into the fire?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said He would prepare destroyers, everyone with his weapons, and they would cut down the choice cedars and cast them into the fire.

answers.text: The vineyards of Samaria
The choice cedars
The gates of the city
The olive trees of the valley

questions.text: When the nations asked why Yahweh had done this to the great city, what answer is given?
questions.explanation: They answer, "Because they abandoned the covenant of Yahweh their God, worshiped other gods, and served them."

answers.text: Because they refused to pay tribute
Because they trusted in their own strength
Because they abandoned Yahweh's covenant and served other gods
Because they would not listen to their own kings

questions.text: Of which son of Josiah did Yahweh say that he would not return to this place any more?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said concerning Shallum the son of Josiah, king of Judah, who reigned instead of Josiah his father, that he would not return there any more but would die in the place where they had led him captive.

answers.text: Shallum
Jehoiakim
Coniah
Zedekiah

questions.text: In the woe of verse 13, what does the man do to his neighbor?
questions.explanation: Woe is pronounced on him who builds his house by unrighteousness, who uses his neighbor's service without wages and does not give him his hire.

answers.text: He takes his field by force
He bears false witness against him
He drives him out of the city
He uses his service without paying him wages

questions.text: What did the father do, so that it was well with him?
questions.explanation: Yahweh asked whether his father did not eat and drink and do justice and righteousness, and says that he judged the cause of the poor and needy, so it was well with him.

answers.text: He built with cedar and painted his rooms
He did justice and judged the cause of the poor and needy
He made a covenant with the nations around
He gathered the treasures of the kings of Judah

questions.text: What kind of burial did Yahweh say Jehoiakim would have?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that Jehoiakim would be buried with the burial of a donkey, drawn and cast out beyond the gates of Jerusalem.

answers.text: The burial of a donkey, cast out beyond the gates of Jerusalem
A burial among the kings of Judah his fathers
A burial in the graves of the common people
No burial at all in any land of his people

questions.text: How did Yahweh say Coniah should be recorded?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Record this man as childless, a man who will not prosper in his days," for no one of his offspring would prosper, sitting on David's throne and ruling in Judah.

answers.text: As a shepherd of the flock of Judah
As a prince who would sit on David's throne
As a servant of Yahweh for ever
As childless, a man who will not prosper in his days
